messages:
kevin.h: Heads-up - discovered a weird one in today's midday emit: several invoices show no compute.gpu line and two customers got the same invoice id twice (duplicate rows in our invoice table). Example: inv_07455b (aurora-ops) has no GPU lines; inv_07458c appears twice.
lina.p: Oof. Which batch?
kevin.h: batch id `midday-2026-11-18-12z`. Emit logs show emit before final aggregation. Snippet:
[12:05:01] emitInvoice(inv_07455b) -> EMITTED total=5,120.00 items=3
[12:05:02] agg: finalizeUsage(inv_07455b) -> COMPLETE added_rows=4
kevin.h: For the duplicate id, DB shows two invoice rows with same invoice_number but different pk ids and different PDFs uploaded. Looks like a race in the invoice creation path.
billing-bot: Automated alert: missing_expected_sku(compute.gpu) (9 ids), duplicate_invoice_number (2 ids). Full report -> s3://billing/alerts/3256789012/report.json
emily: Proposed short plan: 1) Pause outbound email for midday-2026-11-18-12z. 2) Run dry reconcile: `billingctl reconcile --batch midday-2026-11-18-12z --dry --out s3://billing/recons/dry-3256789012.csv`. 3) For net delta <= $8,000 auto-backfill+re-emit with `--no-email`, > $8,000 send to finance-approvals. Approve?
finance-approvals: FYI we use $8k cutoff for this customer cohort. We'll review >$8k cases.
support: If we re-emit, we'll need a customer note explaining duplicate invoice ids and apologizing. I'll draft a template.
lina.p: I'll run the dry-run now. Starting at 3256789030. Early: 9 affected, deltas vary -$30 to +$7,450. No items exceed $8k.
kevin.h: For the duplicate invoice-number cases, ops propose to mark the later PK as orphaned, attach its usage rows to the canonical invoice, and remove the extra PDF object. We'll also add a uniqueness check in the creation flow to prevent this.
emily: Ok proceed with backfill and canonicalization for duplicates, then re-emit with `--no-email` for QA. Support will review templates; finance need not review (all < $8k). Post final recon CSV here when done.
billing-bot: Dry-run complete. CSV uploaded: s3://billing/recons/dry-3256789012.csv. Summary: 9 invoices re-gain compute lines, avg delta +$1,100. No finance escalation.
kevin.h: Running canonicalization and backfill now. Will post logs and re-emit results. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
